title: kb/_self/map.csv maps no doc to _tools/testmap.py, so selfdoc stale never flags tools.md's testmap row
goal: kb/_self/map.csv maps kb/_self/tools.md to _tools/testmap.py, so a change to testmap.py lists tools.md as stale until its testmap row is updated or Self-Reviewed; found while landing BG-rskbmulj, whose testmap rule change left the row out of date with stale=0

run: import csv,fnmatch,sys;rows=list(csv.reader(open("kb/_self/map.csv",encoding="utf-8")));sys.exit(0 if any(r[0]=="kb/_self/tools.md" and fnmatch.fnmatch("_tools/testmap.py",r[1]) for r in rows[1:]) else 1)
